nodes.label: AddDbContextPool
nodes.rationale: Reuses context instances to cut construction overhead; requires contexts hold no per-request state.

nodes.label: Change Tracker (snapshot-based)
nodes.rationale: Snapshot comparison via DetectChanges has cost proportional to tracked entities; AsNoTracking avoids it for read-only queries.

nodes.label: DbContext
nodes.rationale: Acts as session, Unit of Work and Repository; not a long-lived singleton because it is not thread-safe and its change tracker accumulates state.

nodes.label: DbContext Scoped Lifetime
nodes.rationale: Scoped per HTTP request because DbContext is not thread-safe; singletons cause threading violations and stale tracked data.

nodes.label: Fluent API vs Data Annotations
nodes.rationale: Fluent API keeps entities EF-agnostic and exposes the full configuration surface; annotations reserved for simple cases.

nodes.label: SaveChanges() Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Wraps multiple statements in an implicit transaction so a single SaveChanges is atomic.

nodes.norm_label: request walkthrough (spa -> eventscontroller -> ef core -> sqlite)

nodes.label: .graphifyignore
nodes.rationale: Excludes build output, node_modules and NSwag-generated code so the graph reflects real code.

nodes.label: Clean Architecture (shape only, not followed)
nodes.rationale: csproj graph enforces Api->Application->{Domain,Persistence} but controllers call AppDbContext directly and Application is empty; early-stage teaching snapshot.

nodes.label: AsSplitQuery / Cartesian Explosion
nodes.rationale: Avoids duplicated rows from multiple collection includes at the cost of multiple round trips and non-atomic consistency.

nodes.label: Startup MigrateAsync + SeedDataAsync (swallowed errors)
nodes.rationale: Failures are logged not rethrown, so the app can start against a stale schema; seeding is idempotent.

nodes.label: Testing: in-process unit tests on shared SQLite + Bruno HTTP integration tests

nodes.rationale: EF In-Memory provider hides real relational bugs; SQLite in-memory is a stronger fast default.

nodes.label: Code Coverage
nodes.rationale: Diagnostic signal, not a target; chasing percentages yields low-value tests.

nodes.label: Testing Pyramid (Mike Cohn)
nodes.rationale: Bulk of confidence from cheap fast unit tests; reserve slow E2E tests for critical paths.

nodes.label: Graphify git hooks (post-commit/post-checkout)
nodes.rationale: AST-only rebuild is free and never fails the commit; hooks are per-machine since .git/hooks is untracked.

nodes.label: Bruno: Events - Create - 200 (POST /events)

nodes.label: Phase 1 - Discovery (detect stack from real signals)
nodes.norm_label: phase 1 - discovery (detect stack from real signals)
nodes.rationale: Inaccurate architecture docs are worse than none; never assume the stack or claim a pattern the code doesn't follow.

nodes.label: Phase 3 - Generation (per-component READMEs + architecture doc)
nodes.rationale: READMEs tailored per component stack; verify every command against real manifests; default to Mermaid diagrams.

nodes.label: Clean-Architecture-flavored layering
nodes.rationale: Solution is shaped as Domain/Persistence/Application/Api, but CLAUDE.md states Application is an unused placeholder and controllers call AppDbContext directly (note: current EventsController uses Mediator commands/queries from EventsHub.Application, so this description appears stale).

nodes.label: EventsHubBaseController route pattern (api/v1/[controller])
nodes.rationale: All controllers derive from a shared base with [Route("api/v1/[controller]")] and [ApiController] so routing/versioning is uniform; new controllers should follow it.

nodes.label: Generated artifacts - never hand-edit rule
nodes.rationale: EventsHub.v1.json, EventsHubRpcClient.generated.cs and Persistence/Migrations are regenerated by tooling; hand edits would be overwritten.

nodes.label: Shared seeded SQLite test DB convention (GlobalTestSetup)
nodes.norm_label: shared seeded sqlite test db convention (globaltestsetup)
nodes.rationale: DB is seeded once per run and shared, so tests read existing rows (e.g. Events.FirstAsync()) instead of asserting hardcoded counts/IDs, avoiding ordering/seed-count coupling.

nodes.label: Startup MigrateAsync + SeedDataAsync (logged, never rethrown)
nodes.rationale: DB errors are logged but not fatal so the API still starts serving with whatever schema exists.

nodes.label: Api assembly loaded as MVC application part via typeof(WeatherForecastController)
nodes.norm_label: api assembly loaded as mvc application part via typeof(weatherforecastcontroller)
nodes.rationale: Program in EventsHub.Api is an internal top-level type, so a public controller type is used to get the assembly handle; separate port 5011 avoids colliding with the real API on 5001.

nodes.label: Hardcoded API URL in App.tsx (no env base URL)
nodes.norm_label: hardcoded api url in app.tsx (no env base url)
nodes.rationale: Known rough edge: first gap to close before adding more API calls or targeting a non-localhost backend.
